dct_description_sm: This dataset is made available under the Statistics Canada Open Licence Agreement: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/eng/reference/licence. The dataset is in Beyond 20/20 (.ivt) format. The Beyond 20/20 browser is required in order to open it. This software can be freely downloaded from the Statistics Canada website: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/eng/public/beyond20-20 (Windows only).

This dataset is a custom tabulation of the Canadian Business Patterns Product, that includes: establishment counts by census agglomeration (CA) and census metropolitan area (CMA) from December 2009 to December 2011.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Canadian Business Patterns, Census Agglomeration (CA) and Census Metropolitan Area (CMA) Level [custom tabulation]
